suggestions.point: The 'fine_grained_classifier' is tasked with verifying the material of the birds (Atom 4). Standard ImageNet-trained classifiers may struggle to distinguish 'wooden texture' from 'real bird plumage' without specific fine-tuning. It is recommended to rely primarily on the 'perceptual_quality_auditor' or 'open_vocabulary_detector' confidence scores for material verification, or explicitly prompt the VLM in the perceptual auditor to analyze surface reflectance and grain.

The plan correctly identifies that biological checkpoints for 'bird' (comb, wattles) are irrelevant for wooden sculptures. However, it could explicitly assign the 'topology_boundary_auditor' to the birds as well, not just the chair. While the chair has complex spindles, the birds have thin metal legs which are also prone to AI generation artifacts (melting into the base/tray). Adding this would ensure structural integrity of all thin limbs.
